subject: Quick 15-minute sync to review your recent usage spike
message_1_subject: Quick 15-minute sync to review your recent usage spike
message_1_body:
Hi Jordan,

Congrats on the recent traction — I noticed your project on the self-serve plan crossed our 50k token usage threshold last week. That usually signals teams are moving from experimentation to productization and often worth a quick check-in.

I can run a 15-minute walkthrough to: 
- show a quick usage breakdown (tokens by endpoint)
- call out easy wins for latency/cost (batching, KV cache hints)
- share a short checklist teams use to prep for Dedicated or reserved capacity

Are you available for 15 minutes this week? I have open slots:
- Wed 8/16 11:00am–11:15am PT
- Thu 8/17 9:30am–9:45am PT
- Fri 8/18 2:00pm–2:15pm PT

If those don't work, pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-demo. Attached: a 1-page agenda and a CSV snapshot of last week's usage.

Thanks — would be great to learn how you're using prompts and whether latency/cost are blockers.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
SDR, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.inference.com

Attachment(s): redwood-15min-demo-agenda.pdf, usage-snapshot-beacon-20280810.csv

message_3_subject: Re: Quick 15-minute sync — Friday 2:00pm PT OK?
message_3_body:
Perfect — Friday 8/18 at 2:00pm PT works on my end. I'll block a 25-minute window (15-min demo + buffer) and add Ben from Solutions in case we want to cover quota/commits.

Meeting details (calendar invite will follow):
- When: Fri Aug 18, 2028 · 2:00pm–2:25pm PT
- Agenda: 1) quick usage snapshot (3m) 2) latency & cost quick wins (7m) 3) next steps / options (5m)

Before we meet, could you share the following so we can be efficient:
- the primary endpoint you call (chat vs streaming)
- whether you're using KV cache or session-based contexts
- any regulatory constraints (PHI/PII) we should be aware of

I attached the one-pager again and a tiny CSV that shows token distribution by endpoint — will pull a few highlights in the call.

Best,
Mateo

Attachment(s): redwood-15min-demo-agenda.pdf, usage-snapshot-beacon-20280810.csv
